test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S and T appeared in a class test and each scored different marks. T scored more than only one student. S scored more than Q but less than P. Q did not score less than T. Who among them scored the highest marks?
solution:
__**Option 1**__ is the correct answer.

**Students** : P, Q, R, S and T

1) T scored more than only one student. (Thus, T is at the fourth position)

_>_>_>T>_

2) S scored more than Q but less than P. Q did not score less than T. (So Q cannot be the one who scored least marks)

P>S>Q>T>R

Hence, **P** scored the highest marks.
